L8·N8unmasked layer
Fires on the word right after a coordinator in a parallel/list construction — specifically when that word is a function word repeating the phrase structure ("and **for**", "and **about**", "as **well**", "or **just**", list comma) — and is strongly suppressed when a content verb/noun instead follows the "and/or" (e.g. "or **ask**", "and **contacting**", "or **that**").

L8·N63unmasked layer
Fires at clause/sentence-boundary tokens in the middle of a passage — the period, comma, or connective ("and", "regard", "yesterday") right where one statement ends and a restatement/continuation begins — while paragraph-break newlines after sentence-final punctuation (and a few oddities like "sulfur", "!") strongly suppress it.
